mission: §4 NON-PAID comparative pilot — prove where still+Ken-Burns holds cinematic quality vs where real motion is required. Uses existing assets + local derivatives only (€0). Quality criteria LOCKED.

atmosphere_E1_storm.verdict: Ken-Burns ACCEPTABLE — the subject is sea/sky with little intrinsic performance; smooth camera motion reads as cinematic for a static atmosphere beat. Real video adds living water but the difference is marginal for a brief establisher.

action_A1b_bjorn_oar.visualProof: start frame: Björn head BOWED over the oar, calmer sea; end frame: head RAISED to a defiant forward gaze, sea churning with whitecaps, slight camera push-in. The clip carries a performance beat (the head-raise) + living sea.
action_A1b_bjorn_oar.verdict: Ken-Burns FAILS the LOCKED 'credible motion + readable action' criterion — it freezes a single pose, losing the head-raise and the churning sea. Real video REQUIRED.

ciqeLimitation: CIQE temporal (flicker/pop) is NEAR-ZERO for Ken-Burns because the subject is frozen (only the camera moves) — it cannot distinguish 'good stillness' (atmosphere) from 'bad frozen action'. Therefore the video-vs-still decision is a CINEMATIC/human judgment per shot, not a CIQE threshold.

REQUIRE_real_video: living elements (churning sea, fire, crowd, cloth/hair in wind)
Ken-Burns_acceptable: static wide atmosphere/landscape establishers with minimal subject motion
locked detail inserts (an object, a symbol) where nothing moves
verdictByShotType.rule: Choose by the CINEMATIC need, never by unit price. A still is admissible ONLY when the shot has no performance/motion the audience must read.

applicationToClassification.authoritativeSplit: 188 PREMIUM_VIDEO / 232 STILL_ANIMATABLE (f11-fullfilm-shotlist.json) — already still-heavy, NOT video-maximalist
applicationToClassification.QUALITY_SAFEGUARD: the 47 ACTION shots classified as STILL must be reviewed shot-by-shot: any with real motion/performance (per the rule above) should be UPGRADED to video. This may slightly INCREASE cost — a quality improvement, honestly flagged, NOT a saving.
applicationToClassification.COST_lever_already_banked: pricing the 232 stills at €0.03 (their intended medium) is the PROVEN saving (€217 at EXPECTED). Do NOT convert motion shots to stills to cut cost — rejected by the LOCKED criteria.
applicationToClassification.doNotForce: no further still-conversions purely for price; the split must track cinematic need.

PROVEN: still+Ken-Burns is cinematically dead for performance/motion shots (A1b head-raise lost)
still+Ken-Burns is acceptable for static atmosphere (E1)
CIQE cannot gate this — human judgment required
NEEDS_FURTHER_TEST_paid: whether a GENERATED camera-move (model-side) beats a local Ken-Burns for atmosphere (needs a paid A/B under the next tranche)
per-shot acceptance rate of stills vs video at scale (measured only on a tiny sample)

budgetImpact.net: the optimized budget (€171 MIN / €204 EXPECTED / €256 PRUDENT) STANDS — it already prices stills correctly. The 47-ACTION-still review may shift a few shots still->video (small cost UP for quality), offset by any static non-action video shifting to still (small cost DOWN). Net change is within margin; NOT a new headline saving.

status: PILOT COMPLETE (non-paid). Quality criteria UNCHANGED. No motion shot downgraded to a still for price.
